title: Banach fixed point and flow approach for rough analysis
summary: In this paper, we show that the main algebraic assumption required to perform a fixed point argument for rough differential equations implies the algebraic assumption for the Bailleul flow approach. This assumption requires that the rough path associated with the equation is given by a Hopf algebra whose coproduct admits a cocycle and has a tree-like basis. We show that the Hopf algebra of multi-indices does not satisfy the cocycle condition.
